expected_answer.root_cause: CockroachDB's pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_raft.go::replicaAppBatch.ApplyToStateMachine ingests a bulk SST produced by TRUNCATE (containing RANGEKEYDEL range tombstones over the tenant keyspan) and forwards it to Pebble via ingest.go::(*DB).Ingest. Pebble links the SST into L6. Later, a background L6 compaction runs compaction.go::compactionIter.skipInStripe to decide whether each key in the current snapshot stripe should be dropped or carried forward. skipInStripe mishandles a RANGEKEYDEL whose synthetic MVCC timestamp suffix collides with an existing range key in the same stripe: instead of preserving the deletion, it treats it as already-shadowed and drops it from the output sstable. The point keys the deletion was supposed to elide are no longer covered, so subsequent reads on the range surface the deleted rows.
error_chain: Tenant issues TRUNCATE against a large table on range r4217
CockroachDB SQL layer translates TRUNCATE into a bulk SST containing RANGEKEYDEL range tombstones over the keyspan
pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_raft.go::replicaAppBatch.ApplyToStateMachine applies the AddSSTable command at the Raft apply seam
ApplyToStateMachine forwards the SST to Pebble via ingest.go::(*DB).Ingest
Pebble links the ingested SST into L6 alongside an older SST containing the point keys to be deleted
A background L6 compaction iterates both SSTs and invokes compaction.go::compactionIter.skipInStripe for each key in the snapshot stripe
skipInStripe sees a RANGEKEYDEL whose synthetic MVCC suffix matches an existing range key in the same stripe and incorrectly drops the deletion from the output
The output L6 sstable no longer covers the point keys the RANGEKEYDEL was supposed to elide
Subsequent reads on r4217 return the resurrected (deleted) rows; the consistency checker flags the divergence
affected_components: Any tenant range that ingests a bulk SST whose RANGEKEYDEL suffixes collide with existing range keys at L6
expected_answer.remediation: Three layered options: (1) Fix Pebble's compaction.go::compactionIter.skipInStripe to never drop a RANGEKEYDEL that has live point keys beneath it within the same stripe, even when the synthetic MVCC suffix matches an existing range key. (2) Patch upstream Pebble's range_keys.go to disambiguate RANGEKEYDEL identity beyond suffix equality (include the sequence number / kind in the stripe-skip predicate). (3) On the CockroachDB side, mitigate by splitting the TRUNCATE bulk SST in pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_sst_snapshot_storage.go so RANGEKEYDEL tombstones are written with suffixes that cannot collide with the snapshot's existing range keys, or by issuing the deletion as point Clears on small ranges until the Pebble fix lands.
